house.description: Criminal sentencing in cases involving age deception modified.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Public Safety Finance and Policy

additions: (14) an adult offender intentionally deceived a minor victim into believing the offender was also a minor in order to facilitate the commission of the offense; and
This section is effective August 1, 2026, and applies to crimes committed on or after that date.
[609.099] DECEPTION REGARDING AGE AS SENTENCING FACTOR.

When determining an appropriate sentence for a crime, a judge may consider as a relevant factor whether an adult offender intentionally deceived a minor victim into believing the offender was also a minor in order to facilitate the commission of the crime.
This section is effective August 1, 2026, and applies to crimes committed on or after that date.
